title: Android DEX (Dalvik Executable) signature
summary:
An Android DEX file begins with the 8-byte signature 'dex
035\0' (0x64 0x65 0x78 0x0A 0x30 0x33 0x35 0x00) or 'dex
037\0' or 'dex
038\0' or 'dex
039\0' depending on the version.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Followed by SHA-1 checksum (20 bytes) and Adler-32 checksum (4 bytes).
DEX files are executed by the Android Runtime (ART) or Dalvik VM.
